findings.evidence: The sample index jumps 249 -> 290 (40 rows absent) and later runs backwards 724 -> 700, so a block of rows is replayed out of order. 25 timestamps occur twice and one timestamp step is negative (-4320 s at row 684) against a nominal +180 s. 835 rows span indices 1-850. Any per-sample onset in this file is therefore approximate.

From sample 227 to the end (608 samples) 24 columns each hold a single constant value: tag_01, tag_03, tag_06, tag_07, tag_11, tag_13, tag_14, tag_18, tag_19, tag_20, tag_21, tag_22, tag_25, tag_26, tag_28, tag_29, tag_31, tag_33, tag_35, tag_37, tag_40, tag_42, tag_47, tag_50. tag_10 and tag_02 freeze a few samples later (240 and 229). The remaining 28 columns keep moving over the same stretch - tag_08 ramps from 18 to its 100.0 limit and tag_30 climbs from 61 to 96 - so the plant was still changing while these channels stopped updating. Distrust every frozen channel after sample 227; the values they hold (tag_06 at 3000.0, tag_02 at 100.0, tag_13 at 310.29) are not measurements. This is listed against tag_01 as the representative channel; the window and onset apply to all 24.
